title: DOES DEBIASING INEVITABLY DEGRADE THE MODEL PERFORMANCE

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the probability of the language model predicting male versus female pronouns ('he'/'she') given gender-neutral occupation words using generated templates, calculating the Total Direct Effect (TDE) via causal inference, and evaluating bias using the Sentence Encoder Association Test (SEAT) and the gender/occupation subset of the StereoSet benchmark.
